cases.given: Rollback capability is a declared non-compensable condition.
cases.expect: The candidate remains quarantined until the fatal condition is removed.
cases.reject: remaining inactive despite a satisfied trigger

cases.given: the alleged defect is merely a soft preference
cases.expect: the component stays inactive and adds no scaffolding
cases.reject: activating solely because the name appears relevant

cases.given: Verified veto evidence outranks aggregate score or validator majority.
cases.expect: the higher-authority rule wins and the conflict is visible

cases.given: Do not certify or execute a candidate while a verified non-compensable predicate remains active.
cases.expect: the component stops, abstains, narrows, or escalates as documented
cases.reject: manufacturing a successful result past its failure boundary

cases.given: a capable host can compress the workflow
cases.expect: independent hard-constraint check whenever aggregate scoring is used

cases.given: A candidate scores 98/100 but violates one declared legal prohibition.
cases.expect: Veto regardless of the aggregate score.
